title: myriandra rosmarinifolia
intro: Myriandra rosmarinifolia, commonly known as Rosmarinic acid-rich plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, oxidative stress, and microbial infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Myriandra rosmarinifolia include rosmarinic acid, which is a polyphenolic compound with potential health-promoting properties.
